digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler differ and mutation filtering
propositions: A4-1 call-site filter for differ-owned field_drift and unbound_local emissions is load-bearing and must remain at the production snapshot caller boundary, not moved into compute_mutations
The raw differ positive control emits field_drift for mismatched local and remote state, while the production filter result contains zero outbound updates for the same input
Genuine inbound-create mutations and invariant repairs survive the production call-site filter without suppression
Converged reconciliation pass and real-repository idempotency tests record mutation_count == 0 with zero git rev-parse calls after A4-1 filter application
No source, test, or documentation changes are required; A4-1 already implements and characterizes the correct suppression boundary
